body: 27 Nov, lead (from P3-34): the Year in Music history now comes from the Encore server's own play_event; a Tinkerer who attaches an EXISTING Navidrome has scrobbles there that Encore never recorded. Trigger to build: a one-time import of the music server's scrobbles into play_event (needs an admin-read measurement of /api/scrobble on Navidrome 0.64.2 first, or the person's own login at attach time).
